 E.  ORAL STAFF REPORT(S)

Joe Jimenez, Recreation and Community Services Director, announced that the ATGM and youth sports
Friday Nights Flag Football program have begun; announced the dates for three events in October: Golf
Tournament, October 13; Red Ribbon Rally, October 22; Halloween Spooktacular, October 31.

Neema Ghanbari, Public Works Manager, announced that the trimming of all palm trees along Norwalk
Boulevard and residential neighborhoods has been completed; that on October 2 there will be a bid
opening for SCAG STBG Street Rehabillitation; that the LA County Sanitation District sewer trunk
improvement program is moving forward; and provided an update on the re­roofing project.

Elise McCaleb, Community Development Director, announced that she will be representing the City next
week at the International Council of Shopping Centers.

Linda Hollinsworth, Finance Director, announced that AquaTots was added as a worksite to the YEP
program; provided an update on the ERP project and fee study; and that the city received a GFOA
Certificate of Achievement for Excellence in Financial Reporting Program.

Pablo Rubio, City Clerk, announced that the ballot dropbox will open on October 4 for the upcoming
Statewide Special Election.

Ernesto Marquez, City Manager, announced that LA County Sheriff’s Captain Daniel Holguin will provide
an update at the next City Council meeting.

F.  CITY ATTORNEY REPORT(S)

There were no Oral City Attorney Reports.

G.  ORAL COUNCIL REPORT(S)

Councilmember Roa thanked Elise McCaleb for representing the city.

Councilmember Vargas spoke regarding ICE.

Ernesto Marquez, City Manager, spoke.

Councilmember Roa requested an agenda item for the next City Council meeting regarding potential
assistance the city can provide to the community in the event of an ICE raid.

Mayor De Paula spoke.

H.  CLOSED SESSION

There were no Closed Session items.

I.  ADJOURNMENT

The City Council adjourned the meeting at 7:12 PM to the next Regular City Council meeting to be held
on Wednesday, October 8, 2025 at 6:00 PM.
